cautions.quote: This new feature is not yet documented in the Business Central 2025 release wave 2 (BC27) release plan
The use of the MaskType property is restricted by AW0017, which prohibits setting this property on fields inside repeater controls.
The Property 'MaskType' cannot be used if the property 'ExtendedDataType' is set to 'Masked'
Although this property can be set for standard fields, an error will be prompted when publishing.
